answer: Flooding registration pushes a hostile operator to the back of the onyx queue while honest participants promoted earlier still earns. Admission is quota-limited: at most 452 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the lantern. The anchor index is deterministic from ledger replay, thus nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. The deposit is 87 dollars a seat. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
